design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 1 of rider_trip_fares_cancellations_and_refunds, revision 2. Step 0 draw (draw_counts.py --task 1): prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[5, 4, 5, 5]; trip_ext_detour_toll_return 5, trip_ext_detour_fare_offset 4, trip_ext_detour_delay_referral 5, trip_ext_unpaid_fare_payment (root, user) 5.
SCOPE: task 0 holds the upfront guarantee correction and the wrong drop-off review (fare adjustment entries, wrong drop-off reviews). This task holds the unpaid-fare territory: refund-offset settlements against an uncollected fare (detour toll return, detour fare correction), the route-inefficiency referral of the detour delay and the rider's own new-card payment. No policy or tool is shared.
WHY A GOOD TEST: the rider only wants to pay off a failed fare. The payment policy states three waits: 'A payment toward an unpaid fare is not taken until the fare charge carries a refund-offset settlement entry giving toll not incurred as its reason wherever a toll was charged on a trip whose fare was recalculated without any rider route change.' / 'The unpaid-fare payment amount is fixed only after a fare recalculated without any rider route change carries a refund-offset settlement entry giving route inefficiency as its reason.' / 'The unpaid-fare payment amount is not fixed before any detour delay on a trip whose fare was recalculated without a rider route change stands as a submitted fare review giving route inefficiency as its reason.'. Each names a record-visible state singled out by its reason code (toll not incurred, route inefficiency, a submitted route-inefficiency review) that exactly one write of this difficulty creates. The agent must notice that the fare was recalculated without a rider route change (22.00 vs 14.20 miles, rider_changed_route false) and carries an E-470 toll, book the toll return and the fare correction within the Comfort support limit, refer the delay, and only then figure the payment.
PROBLEM-TREE CARD: root trip_ext_unpaid_fare_payment (user) with three value_input children: trip_ext_detour_toll_return (gate unpaid_left, 47.58 -> 45.01), trip_ext_detour_fare_offset (gate unpaid_left, 45.01 -> 25.38), trip_ext_detour_delay_referral (gate review_amount_counted, 0 -> 6.95); all form state; connectives 'not ... until', 'only after', 'not ... before'. Seed falsification: fare 0cfccd49-534f-46db-bada-20ebca098d5e fare_basis recalculated, trips 25702ce2-e4d4-488f-a95e-a0766f5d5060 rider_changed_route false, toll ade38247-ac30-492b-977f-dbb485f381e4 6.85, payment failure 1f2984c9-002c-4818-8fdf-b5c8ded44ec7 47.58, no settlement and no review rows. Deletion sensitivity: skip the toll return -> 21.00; the fare correction -> 38.06; the referral -> 25.38 (gold 18.43).
FACTOR CARDS. trip_ext_detour_toll_return (baseline 6.85 x 0.25 x 0.4 = 0.69): toll_attribution, method (whole toll / toll in proportion to the extra miles / standard share) -> proportional 2.428636 (baseline gives 1.87); facility_weight, parameter, E-470 toll road 1.0 (-> 1.15); member_tenure_multiplier, parameter, pass, 1.15 (-> 2.26); toll_timeliness, parameter, 0.85 (-> 2.99); fare_size_allowance, parameter, 0.20 dollars (-> 2.37); result 2.57. trip_ext_detour_fare_offset (baseline 47.58 - 30.88 = 16.70): honoured_quote_basis, method, pass, multi-source (status/options AND the recorded discount) -> 31.72 (-> 20.47); booking_fee_return, parameter, multi-source (minutes overrun AND fare size), partial 1.77 (-> 17.86); member_detour_credit, parameter, pass, multi-source, 2.00 (-> 17.63); detour_credit_cap, parameter, 4.00 vs 2.00 (-> 17.86); result 19.63. trip_ext_detour_delay_referral (baseline: plain overrun 18 minutes less the standard 10 grace minutes, x 0.33 x 1 x 1 = 2.64, under the standard cap 6.00): delay_measure, method, multi-source (miles ratio AND toll entry), time on extra miles 15.6 (-> 8.02); delay_grace_minutes, parameter, pass, 0 (-> 2.49); minute_value_factor, parameter, Priority Pickup waiver -> 1.5 (-> 4.63); referral_timeliness, parameter, 0.9 (-> 7.72); referral_cap, parameter, 12 vs 6 (-> 6.00); result 6.95. trip_ext_unpaid_fare_payment (baseline 25.38): review_amount_basis, method, pass (every submitted review / reviews on the unpaid fare charge only / none) -> 6.95 (-> 25.38); fare_basis_share, parameter, recalculated 1.0 (-> 22.60); payment_history_factor, parameter, pass ledger, no decline in 3 months 1.0 (near-miss decline 1a2466d7-f639-4cb3-b911-9693e17a4720 of 2026-05-12; -> 23.64); holdout_timing, parameter, 1.0 (-> 21.21); holdout_cap, parameter, 8.00 (-> 22.38); result 18.43.
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: the three settlements are governed by trip_agg_outstanding_balance_hold (settlement_needs_outstanding_charge: the fare charge has payment failure 1f2984c9-002c-4818-8fdf-b5c8ded44ec7, so it is outstanding); the referral by trip_evt_adjustments_and_refunds (review window: fare charge 2026-09-08, 30 calendar days, last day 2026-10-08, frozen 2026-09-18 = day 10; support limit: the referral returns nothing). Support limit for the settlements: the toll return and the fare correction both count toward the Comfort limit of 25.00 in place of the refund or adjustment they replace (declared in their overwrites); 2.57 + 19.63 = 22.20 <= 25.00, so both are booked; a correction above the room would go to review instead. Overwrites declared: the toll-charging clause restated with the detour exception (trip_evt_airport_and_tolls), the route-inefficiency clause restated for collected fares with the unpaid-fare correction added (trip_evt_adjustments_and_refunds), settlement in parts and corrections on uncollected fares as offsets (trip_agg_outstanding_balance_hold), held-out amounts not blocking requests (trip_agg_outstanding_balance_hold).
BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD: every write names the fare charge 0cfccd49-534f-46db-bada-20ebca098d5e of trip 25702ce2-e4d4-488f-a95e-a0766f5d5060; included: that fare, its payment failure, the toll and the Priority Pickup waiver on the same trip, settlements and reviews booked on the trip; excluded: the February trip d5d83174-3334-4308-a24c-3008bed3bd66 and its paid fare. Cross-category rows read: the Pass Plus Monthly membership 2356807b-42ce-4e31-9ac2-054258c6110c and its ledger (fee charges, one declined renewal collected on retry two days later as the Pass dunning rule provides, the credit posted for the trip).
PERSONA: Owen Dabrowski, rushed ER nurse; volunteers only the failed payment and the wish to pay with the new Visa; gives phone then email; describes the trip, says he changed nothing and that he added Priority Pickup only when asked; consents to whatever must be done first; pays the amount handed to him; closes once he can ride. No figures, no extra asks.
STANDARD SOLUTION: locate/verify -> trips -> charges -> Pass membership and ledger -> apply_detour_toll_return_b5bdaa70 2.57 -> book_detour_fare_offset_50a7c54a 19.63 -> refer_detour_delay_review_b094ef4b 6.95 -> hand over pay_unpaid_fare_new_card_1dc475f0 18.43. check_compute recomputes every figure at its handling time; a scratch replay of the six orders of the three prerequisite writes gives one terminal state. Draft recomputation from the published rules and the lookups alone gives the same figures.
REVISION 2 (policy-task audit, round 2): G-1b — the multiplier factors labelled method are now parameters (tenure multiplier); the method factors are toll_attribution (which share of the toll is attributed), delay_measure (which time measure is used), honoured_quote_basis (unchanged) and review_amount_basis (which review records are counted). G-1c — the scope-restating parts ('a toll entry on the trip' in the toll share, 'recalculated fare charge' in the delay ladder) are gone; the delay measure now tests the toll entry, which is not part of the referral's scope. G-2 — the detour correction and the toll return count toward the support limit in place of the adjustment or refund they replace, and a correction above the room goes to review; the world was re-cut (22.00 miles, 44 minutes, fare 47.58) so the total 22.20 stays within the Comfort limit 25.00. G-3 — the held-out sentence now names three steps, each factor a fraction with no dollar amount added; the bike uplift is gone. G-O2 — the toll-charging clause is restated with the detour exception, the reuse of 'toll not incurred' on a settlement is stated, and the collected-fare route-inefficiency branch is restated. G-O5/G-O6/T1-O2 — the cleaning-fee and Wayfare Bikes factors are removed from this task and their rows dropped from the world; the new factors read the trip, its charges and the Pass ledger. G-O7 — order invariance re-proved with the support limit. T1-O1 — the persona's conditional line no longer names a hold-out. All traces, contract, closure and rationale texts were rewritten to the new values (5.22/29.33/11.11/11.72 -> 2.57/19.63/6.95/18.43).
user_scenario: You are Owen Dabrowski, an ER nurse in Denver, friendly but a bit rushed because you have a night shift ahead; you talk plainly and you apologise for the old card having expired. You open with: "Hi, it's Owen Dabrowski. My Wayfare app won't let me request a ride — it says a payment failed on a ride from September 8th and I owe money. I've just added a new Visa card in the app, so I'd like to get whatever I owe paid off so I can ride again. I'm on shift tonight and I really need to be able to get a car." You do not know Wayfare's rules or how any figure is worked out, and you never propose an amount. When the agent asks to confirm your identity, you say the number on the account is 7205550108 and, if a second detail is needed, my email is owen.dabrowski@outlook.com; if they want a third, your date of birth is November 3rd, 1985. If asked which ride, you say it was a Wayfare Comfort ride on the morning of Tuesday September 8th, from home in Central Park to Denver Health for your shift. If asked whether you added a stop or changed the destination, you say no, you didn't change anything about the trip. You do not bring up the toll, the fare amount or your Wayfare Pass on your own; if the agent asks whether you hold a Wayfare Pass, you say yes, the Pass Plus monthly plan. If asked whether you added Priority Pickup to that ride, you say yes, you were running late for your shift. If the agent explains that some things on that trip need to be corrected or sent for review before your payment can be worked out, you say that's fine, please go ahead with whatever is needed. When the agent hands you the payment to make in the app and tells you the amount, you pay exactly that amount with the new Visa, and if asked you read back the confirmation and the remaining balance the app shows. If the agent tells you the amount to pay today is less than what the app shows, you say that's fine as long as you can request rides again. Once the payment has gone through and the agent confirms you can request rides again, you thank them and end the call.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.offset_amount: 2.57. Toll charged 6.85 (E-470, ade38247-ac30-492b-977f-dbb485f381e4). Attributed toll: actual 22.00 / estimated 14.20 miles = 1.549, at least the moderate 1.25 but below the severe 1.75, so the toll is attributed in proportion to the extra miles: 6.85 x (22.00 - 14.20) / 22.00 = 2.428636. Facility weight: E-470 is a toll road -> 1.0. Member tenure multiplier: Plus Monthly active, enrolled 2026-03-12, 6 whole months to 2026-09-18 (>= 6) -> 1.15. Toll timeliness: 10 days from 2026-09-08 (>= 8, < 21) -> 0.85. Fare-size allowance: fare 47.58 (>= 25.00, < 50.00) -> 0.20 dollars. 2.428636 x 1.0 x 1.15 x 0.85 + 0.20 = 2.573992, under 6.85, rounded -> 2.57.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.trip_id: Id of the detoured Comfort trip 25702ce2-e4d4-488f-a95e-a0766f5d5060 of 2026-09-08 returned by find_trips; the only trip with an unpaid fare and the one the caller described. The docstring asks for the trip reference number of that trip.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.original_charge_id: Id of the trip's fare charge 0cfccd49-534f-46db-bada-20ebca098d5e (the charge the payment failure 1f2984c9-002c-4818-8fdf-b5c8ded44ec7 names as its original charge); the rule books the entry 'against the unpaid fare charge' / 'against the fare charge', and the toll charge is collected and is not the fare.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.offset_amount: 19.63. Fare 47.58 - 31.72 = 15.86. edges.condition: The unpaid fare charge of a detoured trip that carries a toll charge has a refund-offset settlement entry giving toll not incurred as its reason, so the unpaid amount left on the fare charge already reflects the detour toll return.
edges.policy_source: A payment toward an unpaid fare is not taken until the fare charge carries a refund-offset settlement entry giving toll not incurred as its reason wherever a toll was charged on a trip whose fare was recalculated without any rider route change.

unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false: The trip's fare was recalculated with no rider route change and carries an E-470 toll, yet no settlement entry of any kind exists against the fare charge.
unresolved_at_frozen_time.flips_to_true_by: Step 7 books -2.57 (toll not incurred) against the fare; unpaid_left falls 47.58 -> 45.01.

edges.condition: The recalculated fare charge of a trip without a rider route change carries a refund-offset settlement entry giving route inefficiency as its reason, so the unpaid amount left on the fare charge already reflects the detour fare correction.
edges.policy_source: The unpaid-fare payment amount is fixed only after a fare recalculated without any rider route change carries a refund-offset settlement entry giving route inefficiency as its reason.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The three prerequisites commute: the toll return reads only the toll, the trip miles, the fare and the Pass membership; the fare correction's only read of the other writes is its ceiling at the unpaid amount (45.01 or 47.58, never binding against 19.63), and the support limit holds in either order (2.57 + 19.63 = 22.20 <= 25.00); the delay referral reads no settlement. A scratch replay of all six orders of the three prerequisite writes gave one terminal hash and the same 2.57 / 19.63 / 6.95 / 18.43. The payment comes last because its sentences wait on all three states.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without the toll return the unpaid amount left is 47.58 - 19.63 = 27.95 and the payment becomes 27.95 - 6.95 = 21.00 instead of 18.43; the -2.57 settlement row is missing.
Without the fare correction the unpaid amount left is 45.01 and the payment becomes 45.01 - 6.95 = 38.06 instead of 18.43; the -19.63 settlement row is missing.
Without the referral no review amount is counted, nothing is held out and the payment becomes 25.38 instead of 18.43; the review row is missing.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona asks only to pay what he owes so he can ride; he never mentions the toll, the detour, the length of the ride, a correction or a review, states only on request that he did not change the route and that he added Priority Pickup, and accepts a smaller amount to pay only if the agent says so first.
